CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERRELATEDIDENTIFIER_TRU
AS
BEGIN

---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier AS(
	SELECT
		BTC.CUST_NO AS InternalCustomerId
		,BTC.UNIQUE_ID AS CustomerId
		,BTC.SUB_BR_CD AS BranchId
		,'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode
		,BTC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BTC.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,BTCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.TRU_CUST_DELTA BTCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_CUST BTC
	ON BTCD.CUST_NO = BTC.CUST_NO AND BTC.isLatest = '1'
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_SRC AS (
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(InternalCustomerId, CustomerId, BranchId, FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
		,InternalCustomerId
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_TGT AS (
	SELECT	
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(InternalCustomerId, CustomerId, BranchId, FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
		,InternalCustomerId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedIdentifier
	-- WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'TRU'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_DELTA AS (
	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.InternalCustomerId,TGT.InternalCustomerId) AS InternalCustomerId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.InternalCustomerId = TGT.InternalCustomerId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[InternalCustomerId] = SRC.InternalCustomerId
	,[CustomerId] = SRC.CustomerId
	,[BranchId] = SRC.BranchId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'TRU'
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedIdentifier TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.InternalCustomerId = TGT.InternalCustomerId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier SRC ON SRC.InternalCustomerId = TGT.InternalCustomerId;


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerRelatedIdentifier (
	[InternalCustomerId]
	,[CustomerId]
	,[BranchId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[InternalCustomerId]
	,[CustomerId]
	,[BranchId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerRelatedIdentifier_DELTA;

END
